dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: ...And in the end, we managed to settle things peacefully.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's great. Good work.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And there I was, wondering how I'd report a full-on conflict with the Fatui to the old man...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: This area is under our jurisdiction by right, so we can do as we please. As to whether our actions might stir up unnecessary trouble... Well, that's a different story.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Oh, wait... You're not from Nod-Krai. There wouldn't have been any problems if you'd have taught them a lesson on our behalf.

choices.text: Why, you should've said so earlier.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: Hahaha. I'll remember that the next time this happens.

choices.text: Would've been glad to be of service.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Whew... busy, busy. Time to compile the reports and send them out. Gotta make sure we're all on the same page...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Let's see, who needs a copy... Squad Leader Olav, who's out in the field pursuing the Wild Hunt. The Sergeant Majors stationed in various regions... Oh yes, and Sir Flins, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you planning to deliver them yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Well, I will have some help from my colleagues — but most of them, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Don't worry, this isn't a manpower issue. More like... a side-effect of the free-spirited nature of most Ratniki.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: If there weren't people like me serving as runners, we'd often end up losing track of such individuals in the field.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Besides, I'd like to pay them all a visit anyway, so it's a win-win for everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: The weather in this area has improved quite a bit, mostly thanks to you two.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Once the dark clouds have dispersed and the sun shines down on us once more, the monsters will no longer be able to sneak out under the cover of darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: And when that day comes, the Lightkeepers stationed here will finally be able to rest.

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: True... Ah, if only it could always be daytime. Say, do you think the sun's kinda like us Ratniki?

response.speaker: Illuga
response.text: I mean, before the sun lit up the skies, the world could only have known darkness. What I'm trying to say is, if it wasn't for the sun, there wouldn't be a "daytime" at all.

choices.text: You'd get daytime off, at most.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: How are things going at the camp, Egle?

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: You're back, sir. Things have been quiet at the camp. No sign of impending enemy attacks in the area.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's good to hear. I was starting to think something might've happened — you look like you have a lot on your mind.

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: No, it's not that. I'm just not used to life at the camp yet... I keep worrying about the folks out on missions...

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: I was just like you when I first became a Lightkeeper. But don't let that stop you from getting your rest, understand?

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: I know, I know. But you're the one who dove straight into the reports as soon as you got back, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Egle
dialogues.text: If anything happens to you, it will slow down the entire investigation squad. So rest when you can. Do it for your squad if not for yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Heh, I'll take note of that...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Vlaicu, have you delivered that report to HQ?

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Of course, sir. In fact, I took this shortcut that almost no one else knows, and managed to complete the return trip in just a third of the usual time.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Glad it all went smoothly. Any instructions from the old man after you turned in the report?

dialogues.speaker: Vlaicu
dialogues.text: Ahem. To quote him verbatim... "If you people had told me this earlier, I'd have sent in a team disguised as treasure hunters to raid the lair of those meddling Fatui in the night."

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: That's exactly what I figured he'd say... And that's why I decided to report the matter only after it was settled.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Alright, is there anything in particular I should know about?

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: No, sir. There's nothing you need to worry about for now. You can leave this to us.

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Thanks a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Just doing our duty, sir.
